comment: Glass Dynamics materials. Units are in the field names. Interlayer and polymer moduli are the secant values at impact strain rates (1e2-1e3 /s), not the long-term values used for wind or snow loads.

provenance.toughness_MPam: published: Wiederhorn, J. Am. Ceram. Soc. 52 (1969) 99, K_Ic 0.75-0.82 MPa m^0.5
provenance.hardness_GPa: published: Vickers hardness of soda-lime glass, 5.4-5.6 GPa (Lawn, Fracture of Brittle Solids, 2nd ed.)
provenance.branching_MPam: published: crack-branching constant A_b, sigma r_b^0.5 = 2.1 MPa m^0.5 (Mecholsky, Rice & Freiman 1974; Quinn, NIST SP 960-17)
provenance.crack_speed_ms: published: terminal crack velocity in soda-lime glass, ~1500 m/s (Schardin 1959; Doll 1975)
provenance.weibull_modulus: published: as-received float glass surfaces, m = 6-8 (Haldimann, Luible & Overend, Structural Use of Glass, 2008)
provenance.weibull_scale_MPa: estimated: characteristic strength of an as-received surface over 1 m^2 under a 60 s load, consistent with EN 16612 f_g,k = 45 MPa at the 5 % fractile
provenance.edge_factor: published: EN 16612:2019 edge-strength factor k_e = 0.8 for cut edges
provenance.corrosion_n: published: stress-corrosion exponent n = 16 in humid air (Wiederhorn & Bolz 1970; ASTM E1300 load-duration factor)
provenance.comminution_MJm3: calibrated: energy absorbed crushing the ballistic cone, fitted so the UL 752 representative laminates stop their rated rounds (tests/test_ballistic.cpp)
provenance.cone_angle_deg: published: Hertzian / ballistic cone half-angle ~68 deg from the load axis in soda-lime glass (Frank & Lawn 1967; Florence 1969 uses 63-68 deg)

provenance.density_kgm3: published: alkali-aluminosilicate cover / aerospace glass data sheets, 2.39-2.45 g/cm3
provenance.youngs_GPa: published: 69-77 GPa for alkali-aluminosilicate glasses (manufacturer data sheets)
provenance.toughness_MPam: published: 0.67-0.71 MPa m^0.5 for the unexchanged glass (manufacturer data sheets)
provenance.hardness_GPa: published: Vickers 5.5-6.5 GPa (manufacturer data sheets, before ion exchange)
provenance.branching_MPam: estimated: taken close to soda-lime (fractography of aluminosilicates gives 1.9-2.2)
provenance.crack_speed_ms: estimated: terminal velocity scales with sqrt(E/rho), slightly above soda-lime
provenance.weibull_modulus: estimated: fusion-drawn surfaces are more uniform than float surfaces
provenance.edge_factor: estimated: same cut-edge factor as float glass
provenance.corrosion_n: estimated: aluminosilicates are less sensitive to stress corrosion than soda-lime
provenance.comminution_MJm3: estimated: scaled from soda-lime by hardness

provenance.density_kgm3: published: PVB interlayer data sheets, 1.07 g/cm3
provenance.youngs_GPa: published: initial modulus of PVB at strain rates 1e2-1e3 /s, 0.1-0.4 GPa (Iwasaki et al. 2007; Morison 2007)
provenance.shear_MPa: estimated: PVB shear modulus at 20 C for millisecond loads from published Prony series, 10-50 MPa
provenance.tensile_MPa: published: tensile strength at high strain rate, ~30-35 MPa (Liu et al. 2012)
provenance.flow_MPa: published: high-rate yield / plateau stress of PVB, 15-25 MPa (Liu et al. 2012)
provenance.failure_strain: published: elongation at break at high rate, 150-250 % (Iwasaki et al. 2007)

provenance.density_kgm3: published: ionoplast interlayer data sheets, 0.95 g/cm3
provenance.youngs_GPa: published: 0.3-0.9 GPa at room temperature (manufacturer data sheet)
provenance.shear_MPa: published: ~100+ MPa shear relaxation modulus at 20 C, 1 s (manufacturer data sheet)
provenance.tensile_MPa: published: 34.5 MPa tensile strength (manufacturer data sheet)
provenance.failure_strain: published: elongation at break ~400 % quasi-static; lower at impact rates (estimated 300 %)

provenance.density_kgm3: published: aliphatic TPU film data sheets, 1.1 g/cm3
provenance.youngs_GPa: estimated: secant modulus at impact rates
provenance.shear_MPa: estimated: soft at room temperature; why polycarbonate-faced and aircraft laminates use it
provenance.failure_strain: published: elongation at break 400-500 % (TPU film data sheets)

provenance.tensile_MPa: published: 65-70 MPa at yield, higher at impact rates
provenance.flow_MPa: published: yield ~62-65 MPa quasi-static (raised slightly for rate)
provenance.failure_strain: estimated: 110-150 % quasi-static, reduced for impact rates
